prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1011; do not mention it.)
text:
I write on behalf of our client regarding a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle sideswiped our client's vehicle while changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is now seeking appropriate compensation.

Please direct all future communications concerning this matter, including requests for statements, scheduling, and settlement discussions, exclusively to this office. Our client should not be contacted directly by you or any representative of your company.

We ask that you provide the policy limits of liability coverage for the insured driver and vehicle involved in this collision, along with written confirmation of the policy number and coverage period.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle inspection and repair records, adjuster notes, recorded statements, and any electronic data from either vehicle. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or repaired without prior notice to this office.
